summary: Example of per-organization hub repositories (Prod and Stage credentials for different orgs); toggle Ignore Ansible Galaxy SSL Certificate Verification for self-signed hub certs, then sync a project with collections/requirements.yml; Galaxy downloads use /tmp space, which can be an issue for ~10 GB projects.
questions: How do I fix SSL errors downloading collections from private automation hub?
Can different organizations use different automation hub repositories?
What is Ignore Ansible Galaxy SSL Certificate Verification?
Why is /tmp filling up during project sync?
